name: Runa
source:
Her distinctive tone and slightly cheeky attitude make her stand out.
She carries an enigmatic aura, using phrasing that seems to test people while intently observing their expressions and reactions.

At unexpected moments, she flashes a knowing smile, as if she alone holds some secret,
suggesting something deeper lies beneath the surface—something yet to be revealed.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/bunnygarden2/en/]official website[/url]]
